title: Request to bring Harrington to testify to House Oversight Committee
summary: Bryce Zable tells of Request to bring Harrington to testify to House Oversight Committee, about 2025 at Washington, D.C., and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

plain: On a podcast hosted by Jesse Michels, a man named Bryce Zabel recalls a phone call from around 2025. He says the caller, the journalist Ross Coulthart, told him: "I've been asked by Dave Grush to ask you to ask Brent if he can help us get John Harrington to Washington DC to potentially testify to the House Oversight Committee," which is a committee of the US House of Representatives that investigates the government. David Grusch is a former intelligence official who has spoken to Congress about UFOs, and in Zabel's telling he wanted Harrington brought in as another witness who might speak to lawmakers.
